# Pixel8 Multimedia

## Summary
Pixel8 Multimedia is a UK-based premium pop culture wall art studio and bespoke photo transformation service. We create canvas prints, poster prints, and custom commissions inspired by pop culture, music, film, sport, and modern design across 10+ distinctive art styles.

## Brand
- **Name:** Pixel8 Multimedia
- **Tagline:** Pop. Art. Motion.
- **Legal name:** The Metavision Multimedia Limited (Pixel8 Multimedia is a trading name)

- **Registered office:** 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF
- **VAT no.:** GB 503 7530 17
- **Location:** 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF, United Kingdom
- **Website:** https://pixel8multimedia.co.uk
- **Delivery:** prints to UK addresses only; digital files anywhere

## Products

### Wall Art (Our Way)
All artwork is produced in-house in the UK and made to order. Available in three formats and three sizes:

**Formats:**
- Poster Print — sleek, high-definition satin finish ready for framing
- Canvas (Standard Frame) — a clean, modern look with a solid colour wrap on the edges, sampled from the edges of the design, so the full design stays on the front
- Canvas (Gallery Frame) — deep-edge premium presentation with the same solid colour wrap

**Sizes (square):**
- Small — 12×12 inches
- Medium — 16×16 inches
- Large — 20×20 inches

**Pricing:**
- Poster Prints: from £9.99 (Small) to £16.99 (Large)
- Canvas Standard Frame: from £27.99 (Small) to £44.99 (Large)
- Canvas Gallery Frame: from £29.99 (Small) to £47.99 (Large)

### Design Options
Every character comes in ten exclusive designs, labelled Option A to Option J. Each option is a different interpretation of the character (colour palette, mood and artistic treatment), shown side by side on the character's page.

## Custom Services (Your Way)

### Photo Restoration
AI-enhanced technology combined with human artistry to restore, repair, and revitalise old or damaged photographs.
- Standard Restoration: from £25
- Advanced Restoration: from £45
- Full Reconstruction: from £75

### Stills to Reels
Signature service transforming static images into dynamic, cinematic animations.
- Basic Animation: from £35
- Standard Animation: from £55
- Premium Animation: from £85

### Bespoke Commission
Fully custom pop culture artwork tailored to client briefs.
- Pricing: from £45

## Shipping
- UK standard delivery: 3-6 working days (made to order)
- UK delivery £4.95; free on orders of £50 and over
- Prints aren't delivered outside the UK yet; digital files can be delivered anywhere
